discovered_issues.description: merge_agent_outputs.py writes to reports/<slug>-phase2.json but phase3_gate.py reads from reports/phase2/<slug>-phase2.json. Manual cp required after every merge step.
discovered_issues.action: Fix in session 24 or a dedicated maintenance session. Add --output-path flag or update default output path in merge_agent_outputs.py.

discovered_issues.description: phase3_apply_review.py 'upgrade' logic only applies when phase2 finding has verdict in ('REVIEW', 'FP'). Backwpup agents set verdict='TP' for all uncertain findings — so 14 Claude LLM 'upgrade' recommendations are silently dropped. The gate's validation_status (UNCERTAIN) is never updated to PLAUSIBLE/CONFIRMED.
discovered_issues.action: Fix in session 24: change apply_review.py 'upgrade' branch to also target gate's validation_status field, or remove the phase2 verdict pre-check when the gate has already classified the finding as UNCERTAIN.

discovered_issues.description: benchmark/compare.py uses phase2.findings[].verdict (agent self-assessment: TP/FP/REVIEW) not gate validation_status to compute TP/FP/FN. This means phase3 gate output is ignored by benchmark. Pipeline produces UNCERTAIN findings at gate but benchmark sees TP from phase2 and counts as FP vs ground truth when sink locations don't match. Benchmark metric (QS=0.0) does not reflect true pipeline capability.
discovered_issues.action: Investigate whether benchmark should use gate validation_status or keep using phase2 verdict. If gate is the authoritative output, benchmark should read from phase3 gate JSON not phase2. Document decision.
